Maine Grok MD / prompt.md file mein second line pe OpenAI API key daali hai. Us key ka naam "memo API key" hai.

Ab usi key ko use karke GPT-6 Luna model se incremental codebase update system banao aur run karo.

Requirements:
- Pehli baar full codebase ka detailed summary banao (structure, main files, current status, pending work, known issues).
- Summary ko ek file mein save karo (jaise codebase_summary.md).
- Har next run mein sirf git diff + previous summary use karo.
- Naya summary generate karke usi file ko update karo.
- Output mein clearly dikhao: kya change hua, kya complete, kya pending, kya bugs/issues hain.

GPT-6 Luna model use karna hai. Abhi ek baar full run kar do taaki main dekh sakun kaise kaam kar raha hai.

Maine system bana diya aur chala bhi diya: pehle ek full run kiya, phir ek incremental run se check kiya ki diff wala mode bhi kaam karta hai. Dono `gpt-6-luna` model pe chale aur summary `codebase_summary.md` mein save ho gayi.

**Key:** "Grok MD / prompt.md" naam ki koi file nahi mili. Key `groq_key.md` ki line 2 (`MEMO_API_GPT_KEY`) se li hai. Ye file gitignored hai, aur key na print hui, na kisi file mein likhi gayi.

**Kaise chalta hai** (`scripts/codebase-summary.js`):
- **Pehli run (ya `--full`):** tracked files bhejta hai (101 files, lagbhag 126k input tokens), aur poori summary banata hai: structure, main files, current status, kya complete, kya pending, known issues.
- **Agli runs:** pichli summary + `git diff` (last base commit se) + commits + nayi untracked files bhejta hai. Is baar lagbhag 4k tokens lage. Upar ek **"Changes since last run"** section aata hai, aur baaki summary update ho jaati hai.
- Base commit file ki pehli line mein comment ki tarah save hota hai, isliye har run pichli run se aage ka diff leta hai.
- Model ko bhejne se pehle har file aur diff `src/redact.js` se mask hota hai. `.specstory/`, session transcripts, `*.patch`, `memory/` aur `*_key.md` files bheji hi nahi jaatin.

**Model ko codebase mein kya mila (short mein):**
- **Pending:** P6 Windows end-to-end run, README, aur `PHASE0_FINDINGS.md` bharna.
- **Issues:**
  - Test blocker `E-7bfef16e` ka status saaf nahi hai: ek jagah failed dikhta hai, baad ke notes mein tests pass dikhte hain.
  - Phase 2 ke docs aur memory files ek doosre se mel nahi khate.
  - `README.md` abhi sirf placeholder hai.
  - `git_committer.bat` mein `git add .` aur hardcoded remote push hai.

**Commands:**
```
node scripts/codebase-summary.js          # incremental
node scripts/codebase-summary.js --full   # poora dobara
```
Model badalna ho to `MEMO_SUMMARY_MODEL` set karo.

`npm test` nahi chalaya, kyunki existing code mein koi badlav nahi hua, sirf ek nayi script aayi hai. Kuch commit nahi kiya. `scripts/codebase-summary.js` aur `codebase_summary.md` abhi untracked hain; commit karna hai ya nahi, aap batao.
